description: Teal at the base, gold at the tip, and light as nothing. Scribes want the bird; nobody has found the bird.
lore: Split, cut and shaved it makes a better nib than iron: it holds ink through a whole line and it does not weep in wet weather. [[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] has written the Chronicle with them since she began and buys every one that reaches the meadow. She has also written, at the front of each volume, in that same ink, that the entire book is being set down with a feather off an animal not one person in this country has ever seen, and that she wishes this noted. Under it, in a later hand: still no bird.
gm_notes: Bettany being funny in her own margins. The running annotation is a recurring gag with a cold floor under it: her one certain source is an animal with no witness.
